parameters.jsCode: const p=$input.first().json; const data={'ana@exemplo.test':[90,'regular'],'bruno@exemplo.test':[60,'regular'],'carla@exemplo.test':[80,'pendente']}; let s=''; if(typeof p.email!=='string'||typeof p.actor!=='string'||!p.email||!p.actor)s='entrada_invalida';else if(p.actor!==p.email)s='acesso_negado';else if(!p.email.includes('@')||p.modulo!=='M12'||p.turma!=='T1')s='entrada_invalida';else if(!Object.hasOwn(data,p.email))s='nao_localizado';else if(data[p.email][1]!=='regular')s='pendente';else s=data[p.email][0]>=75?'apto':'nao_apto'; return [{json:{status:s,cenario:'sintetico',policy:'certificado.v1'}}];
